verdict.rationale: Vanta documents official, type-safe SDKs generated from an OpenAPI specification, but the evidence scopes them only to the Auditor API. The main Manage Vanta and integration-building APIs (documents, policies, tests, custom resources) are shown only as raw REST usage with access tokens. The OpenAPI spec was also not found at common public paths. Missing for 10: SDK coverage for the Manage Vanta and integration APIs, a list of supported languages with install and usage docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
